role: Forward Deployed Engineer Intern - AI & Enterprise Systems
jd:
Overview

Rambus , a premier chip and silicon IP provider making data faster and safer , is seeking to hire an exceptional  Forward Deployed Engineer Intern - AI & Enterprise Systems  to jo i n our IT Business /AI Transformation team in SanJose, CA . In this role, you will be working with some of the brightest inventors and engineers in the world develop ing products that make data faster and safer.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer Intern - AI & Enterprise Systems , you’ll play a pivotal role in ( turn real business problems into practical prototypes and working solutions using AI, automation, data, and enterprise technologies ). In this part-time role, you’ll report directly to our Director, Business/AI Transformation . Our Business Transformation team is focused on modernizing enterprise systems and processes, and your contributions will help accelerate innovation and improve how work gets done across Rambus.

Rambus offers a flexible work environment , embracing a hybrid approach for most office-based roles . E mployees are encouraged to spend an average of at least three days per week onsite , allowing for two days of remote work .

Responsibilities



-  Partner with business and IT stakeholders to understand problems, workflows, data, and desired outcomes. 
-  Design and build simple prototypes using AI, automation, data, APIs, and enterprise platforms. 
-  Support enterprise transformation initiatives across ERP, Workday, Salesforce, integrations, and analytics. 
-  Analyze data and processes to identify manual work, gaps, and opportunities for improvement. 
-  Document solutions, test with users, incorporate feedback, and present results to stakeholders. 
-  Follow Rambus security, privacy, data-handling, and responsible AI requirements. 

Qualifications



-  Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science , Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field. 
-  Working knowledge of Python, SQL, APIs, or another modern programming language. 
-  Interest in AI, automation, enterprise applications, and solving business problems with technology. 
-  Ability to learn quickly, work through ambiguity, and communicate clearly with technical and business audiences. 
-  Experience with Git, cloud platforms, Power BI, Power Platform, or large language models is a plus. 

About Rambus

Rambus is a global company that makes industry-leading memory interface chips and Silicon IP to advance data center connectivity and solve the bottleneck between memory and processing. With over 30 years of semiconductor experience, we are a leading provider of high-performance products and innovations that maximize the bandwidth , capacity and security for AI and other data-intensive workloads. Our world-class team is the foundation of our company, and our innovative spirit drives us to develop the cutting-edge products and technologies essential for tomorrow’s systems.

Rambus offers a competitive compensation package including base salary, bonus, equity, matching 401(k), employee stock purchase plan, comprehensive medical and dental benefits, time-off program, and gym membership.

The US salary range for this full-time position is $25.80 to $47.80 . Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location. The successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions.

At Rambus, we are committed to fostering a workplace where every individual is respected, supported, and empowered to succeed. We value a range of perspectives and experiences that contribute to innovation and collaboration. Our goal is to ensure that all team members have equitable access to opportunities, resources, and a sense of belonging. We believe that a culture of fairness and inclusion helps us all do our best work.

Rambus is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Rambus is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans during our job application procedures. If you require assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please feel free to inform us in your application.

Rambus does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies or fee-based recruitment services.

For more information about Rambus, visit rambus.com. For additional information on life at Rambus and our current openings, check out  rambus.com/careers/ .

role: AI Agent Developer Intern (Supply Chain IT - AI & Enablement)
jd:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.   
 Summary of Program   
 Jabil’s Summer Internship Program was recognized as one of the Top 100 Internship Programs in the country for 2026 by WayUp. This is the result of a holistic and engaging experience that summer interns at Jabil experience. As a result, interns that are a part of this program for summer 2027 will get to engage with members of Jabil’s leadership team and participate in events related to professional development, networking & socializing, and community engagement. In addition, interns will have the opportunity to work with each other in committees, be assigned a mentor, tour some of Jabil’s facilities and much more! If this sounds like a program you want to be a part of and you want to work for a company that strives to make EVERYTHING BETTER and ANYTHING POSSIBLE, then apply today.    

 Summary of Position 
 The AI Agent Developer Intern will join Jabil's Supply Chain IT - AI & Enablement team and contribute directly to the evolution of the Supply Chain platform and its growing Generative AI capabilities. This role provides hands-on experience developing AI-powered solutions that help users classify supply chain materials, answer supply chain questions through conversational interfaces, and surface intelligent recommendations. The team leverages modern technologies including AWS Bedrock, cloud-native services, APIs, and enterprise data platforms. The intern will gain practical experience building and testing AI agents, developing supporting services and tools in Python, creating automated tests, validating AI outputs, and documenting solutions. The position offers close collaboration with experienced developers, contractors, and team mentors while contributing to real business initiatives. This internship is designed as a potential pathway to a full-time AI Agent Developer position based on performance and business need. 

 Essential Duties and Responsibilities 
 
• Assist with the design, development, and testing of AI agents and supporting tools using Python. 
• Develop and maintain unit tests for APIs and AI services to improve reliability and test coverage. 
• Support prompt engineering efforts and contribute to reusable AI agent capabilities. 
• Evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, explainability, and quality. 
• Query and validate business data using SQL and Snowflake to ensure solution accuracy. 
• Assist with data processing and workflow automation across AI-enabled business processes. 
• Create and maintain technical documentation, including service documentation, runbooks, and user guides. 
• Participate in Agile development activities including sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and code reviews. 
• Research emerging AI technologies, agent frameworks, and industry best practices. 
• Collaborate effectively with IT, data, engineering, and business stakeholders. 
 Qualifications 
 
• Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in one of the following disciplines: 
• Computer Science 
• Software Engineering 
• Computer Engineering 
• Information Systems 
• Data Science 
• Analytics 
 Required Technical Skills 
 Candidates should possess academic, internship, or project-based experience in the following areas: 
 
• Python programming 
• REST API development and testing 
• Unit testing methodologies 
• SQL and database fundamentals 
• Data analysis and data validation 
• Process automation 
• Cloud computing fundamentals 
• Effective written and verbal communication skills 
 Preferred Technical Skills 
 Experience in any of the following areas is considered a plus: 
 
• Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, or AI agent frameworks 
• AWS services such as Bedrock, Lambda, ECS, and S3 
• Angular 
• .NET / C# 
• Git and Azure DevOps 
• CI/CD practices and tools 
• Microsoft Copilot or Copilot Studio 
• Supply chain, manufacturing, ERP, SAP, or Kinaxis solutions
